title: Separate reading and display roles
guidance: Separate body, UI, heading and decorative letters; confine authorized expression to its region.
guidance_fi: Erota leipäteksti, käyttöliittymä, otsikko ja koristeellinen kirjain. Rajaa hyväksytty muotoilu kyseiseen alueeseen.
condition: When reviewing separate reading and display roles in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Keep decorative A separate from the body copy.

title: Record numeric provenance
guidance: Record size, unit, medium, version and source; distinguish observations, computed ratios and proposals.
guidance_fi: Kirjaa koko, yksikkö, media, versio ja lähde. Erota havainto, laskettu suhde ja ehdotus.
condition: When reviewing record numeric provenance in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Ratio 2:1 is a computed project example, not a Finnish norm.

title: Declare the actual language
guidance: Use fi, or fi-FI where region matters; mark language changes. Swedish sv and Northern Sami se are not Finnish.
guidance_fi: Käytä suomelle fi-tunnistetta ja tarvittaessa fi-FI-tunnistetta. Merkitse vieraskieliset jaksot erikseen; sv ja se eivät ole suomea.
condition: When reviewing declare the actual language in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Declare the English quotation separately.

title: Choose register explicitly
guidance: Do not turn standard prose into colloquial or easy language without permission; easy language needs audience and content review.
guidance_fi: Älä muuta yleiskieltä puhekieleksi tai selkokieleksi ilman lupaa. Selkokieli vaatii kohderyhmän ja sisällön arviointia.
condition: When reviewing choose register explicitly in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Ask the requested register; do not infer easy language from large text.

title: Organize for the reader
guidance: Expose actor, condition, deadline and next action; distinguish the short action label from explanatory prose.
guidance_fi: Tee toimija, ehto, määräaika ja seuraava toiminto näkyviksi. Erota lyhyt toimintopainike selittävästä tekstistä.
condition: When reviewing organize for the reader in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Keep application deadline in readable text.

title: Preserve letters and length
guidance: Preserve ä, ö, å, names and repeated vowels/consonants. Tuli, tulli and tuuli are different words.
guidance_fi: Säilytä ä, ö, å, nimet sekä toistuvat vokaalit ja konsonantit. Tuli, tulli ja tuuli ovat eri sanoja.
condition: When reviewing preserve letters and length in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Do not collapse repeated letters.

title: Preserve Unicode bytes
guidance: Never overwrite original bytes with normalized analysis text; do not split combining sequences or grapheme clusters.
guidance_fi: Älä korvaa alkuperäistä normalisoidulla analyysitekstillä. Älä katkaise yhdistelmämerkkiä tai grafeemiryhmää.
condition: When reviewing preserve unicode bytes in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Derived NFC equality does not permit byte replacement.

title: Check coverage and rights
guidance: Test real names and äöå in the actual font; verify use and redistribution rights. Fonts are not bundled.
guidance_fi: Kokeile oikeita nimiä ja äöå-merkkejä todellisella fontilla. Tarkista käyttö- ja jakeluoikeudet; fontteja ei sisälly pakettiin.
condition: When reviewing check coverage and rights in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Inspect actual glyphs; family name alone proves no coverage.

title: Preserve compounds
guidance: Do not insert spaces into long compounds for layout; consult a dictionary or language reviewer for uncertain boundaries.
guidance_fi: Älä lisää välilyöntejä pitkään yhdyssanaan ulkoasun vuoksi. Tarkista epävarma sananraja sanakirjasta tai kielen asiantuntijalta.
condition: When reviewing preserve compounds in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Do not insert spaces to make the word fit.

title: Distinguish hyphen functions
guidance: Preserve lexical hyphens such as linja-auto; do not conflate hyphens, minus signs and range dashes.
guidance_fi: Säilytä sanan yhdysmerkki, esimerkiksi linja-auto. Älä korvaa yhdysmerkkiä, miinusmerkkiä ja ajatusviivaa samalla säännöllä.
condition: When reviewing distinguish hyphen functions in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Lexical hyphen and range dash have different roles.

title: Review hyphenation boundaries
guidance: Review syllable and compound boundaries; avoid leaving an isolated vowel at a line edge and respect name/abbreviation constraints.
guidance_fi: Arvioi tavujen ja yhdyssanan osien rajat. Vältä yksittäisen vokaalin jättämistä riville; suojaa nimet ja lyhenteet.
condition: When reviewing review hyphenation boundaries in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Treat a shown break as a trial; verify dictionary and context.

title: Verify actual hyphenation
guidance: hyphens:auto alone proves nothing; test language, dictionary, browser, OS and actual break positions.
guidance_fi: Pelkkä hyphens:auto ei todista onnistumista. Tarkista kieli, sanasto, selain, käyttöjärjestelmä ja todelliset katkaisukohdat.
condition: When reviewing verify actual hyphenation in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Record actual break positions in the target browser.

title: Protect case suffixes
guidance: Preserve abbreviation, number and unit suffixes such as EU:ssa, 10 %:n and 25 km:n; do not detach them.
guidance_fi: Säilytä lyhenteiden, lukujen ja yksiköiden päätteet: EU:ssa, 10 %:n, 25 km:n. Älä irrota päätettä kannastaan.
condition: When reviewing protect case suffixes in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Retain suffix colon and grammatical ending.

title: Respect quotation context
guidance: Finnish quotation may use ”näin”; retain the approved house style, foreign quotation and code literals.
guidance_fi: Suomalaisessa lainauksessa voidaan käyttää merkkejä ”näin”. Säilytä hyväksytty tyyli, vieraskielinen lainaus ja koodin merkit.
condition: When reviewing respect quotation context in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Do not change code quote bytes to prose punctuation.

title: Review heading function
guidance: Use sentence-style capitalization for ordinary headings; preserve names and intentional brand case. Judge end punctuation by function.
guidance_fi: Tavallinen otsikko alkaa isolla alkukirjaimella; säilytä erisnimet ja tarkoituksellinen brändityyli. Arvioi loppumerkki otsikon tehtävän mukaan.
condition: When reviewing review heading function in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Preserve proper-name capitalization.

title: Review syntax and protected spans
guidance: Do not insert a comma before every conjunction; review slash spacing in context and protect URLs/code.
guidance_fi: Älä lisää pilkkua aina konjunktion eteen. Arvioi vinoviivan välit asiayhteydessä; suojaa URL-osoitteet ja koodi.
condition: When reviewing review syntax and protected spans in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Do not insert prose slash spacing inside a URL.

title: Separate prose and machine values
guidance: Finnish prose uses decimal commas and grouping spaces; preserve IDs, years, version strings and API values.
guidance_fi: Suomalaisessa tekstissä desimaalierotin on pilkku ja ryhmittelyssä käytetään väliä. Säilytä tunnukset, vuosiluvut, versiot ja API-arvot.
condition: When reviewing separate prose and machine values in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Keep localized prose and machine version strings separate.

title: Keep value-unit groups together
guidance: Check spacing and suffixes across values, units, percent and currency; do not infer currency from region alone.
guidance_fi: Tarkista luvun, yksikön, prosenttimerkin ja valuutan välit sekä taivutuspääte. Älä päättele valuuttaa aluekoodista.
condition: When reviewing keep value-unit groups together in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Keep value, unit and ending accessible at narrow width.

title: Distinguish prose and machine dates
guidance: Preserve machine ISO forms; review prose dates, lowercase month names and context-dependent time punctuation.
guidance_fi: Säilytä koneellinen ISO-muoto. Arvioi tekstin päiväys, kuukauden pieni alkukirjain sekä pisteen ja kaksoispisteen käyttö ajan ilmauksessa.
condition: When reviewing distinguish prose and machine dates in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Preserve machine date when it is part of an identifier/API.

title: Keep sorting separate
guidance: Verify collation version and runtime behavior; never replace original names with sorting keys.
guidance_fi: Tarkista käytössä olevan aakkostuksen versio ja vertailijan toiminta. Älä muuta alkuperäisiä nimiä lajitteluavaimen mukana.
condition: When reviewing keep sorting separate in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Test actual collator instead of replacing letters.

title: Keep semantic hierarchy
guidance: Choose heading level from document structure, not visual size; smaller-screen sizes do not change semantics.
guidance_fi: Valitse otsikkotaso rakenteen eikä fonttikoon perusteella. Pienen näytön otsikkokoko ei muuta asiakirjan rakennetta.
condition: When reviewing keep semantic hierarchy in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Preserve semantic hierarchy during responsive styling.

title: Make information accessible
guidance: Prefer real text where equivalent presentation is possible; distinguish logos from essential information and review alternatives/reading order.
guidance_fi: Suosi oikeaa tekstiä, kun sama esitys voidaan toteuttaa sillä. Erota logo ja välttämätön tieto; arvioi vaihtoehtoinen teksti ja lukujärjestys.
condition: When reviewing make information accessible in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.text: price drawn inside a poster image
example.note: Provide equivalent price information and correct reading order.

title: Allow content to fit
guidance: Allow long compounds and action labels to wrap; avoid hiding content with fixed heights or forced width compression.
guidance_fi: Anna pitkille sanoille ja toimintopainikkeille tilaa rivittyä. Älä piilota sisältöä kiinteällä korkeudella tai kirjainleveyden pakolla.
condition: When reviewing allow content to fit in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Trial multi-line button labels without clipping.

title: Scope size proposals
guidance: Record font, width, distance and role before proposing ratios; a measured page does not establish a national rule.
guidance_fi: Kirjaa fontti, leveys, katseluetäisyys ja rooli ennen kokosuhdetta. Yhden sivun mittaus ei ole suomalainen yleissääntö.
condition: When reviewing scope size proposals in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Example proposal only; test font, width and reader.

title: Preserve font distinctions
guidance: Distinguish Text/Headline, weight, width and optical size; confirm the actual font supports proposed axes.
guidance_fi: Erota Text ja Headline sekä paino, leveys ja optinen koko. Varmista, että todellinen fontti tukee ehdotettuja akseleita.
condition: When reviewing preserve font distinctions in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Verify real font axes before assigning optical size.

title: Scope Suomi.fi tokens
guidance: Use Suomi.fi values only in that system; distinguish Source Sans 3 from older Source Sans Pro and separate body, lead and heading roles.
guidance_fi: Käytä Suomi.fi-arvoja vain kyseisen järjestelmän yhteydessä. Erota Source Sans 3 vanhasta Source Sans Prosta sekä teksti-, lead- ja otsikkoroolit.
condition: When reviewing scope suomi.fi tokens in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Keep current and older Suomi.fi font guidance separate.

title: Scope HDS tokens
guidance: Pin HDS tokens to their source version; state the root size for rem conversion. A token is not permission for every role.
guidance_fi: Liitä HDS-arvot lähdeversioon. Ilmoita rem-muunnoksen juurikoko; tunnuksen olemassaolo ei tarkoita soveltuvuutta joka rooliin.
condition: When reviewing scope hds tokens in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: State this conversion assumption; do not assume every project uses it.

title: Separate brand settings
guidance: Do not mix Kela and Kanta fonts; Kela web hyphenation/size policy is not universal Finnish guidance.
guidance_fi: Älä sekoita Kelan ja Kannan fontteja. Kelan verkkotekstin tavutus- tai kokoratkaisu ei ole kaikkien suomalaisten sivujen sääntö.
condition: When reviewing separate brand settings in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: A Kela no-auto-hyphenation policy does not forbid all Finnish hyphenation.

title: Scope Helsinki rules
guidance: Separate Helsinki-name restrictions from body text and current fonts from historical ones; Office substitutions are medium-specific.
guidance_fi: Erota Helsingin nimen tavutusrajoitus yleisestä leipätekstistä ja nykyinen fontti historiallisesta. Office-korvaus on mediakohtainen.
condition: When reviewing scope helsinki rules in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: A city-name restriction does not automatically apply to ordinary body words.

title: Separate university media
guidance: Do not transfer University of Helsinki print/video sizes to web body text; test äöå clearance in the actual font.
guidance_fi: Älä siirrä Helsingin yliopiston painetun aineiston tai videon mittoja verkkoleipätekstiin. Tarkista äöå-merkkien riviväli oikealla fontilla.
condition: When reviewing separate university media in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Do not transplant caption pixel values to web body copy.

title: Scope Finlandica examples
guidance: Retain Finlandica Text/Headline roles and pt units; do not convert application tracking to CSS without unit evidence.
guidance_fi: Säilytä Finlandican Text/Headline-roolit ja pt-yksiköt. Älä muunna sovelluskohtaista merkkiväliä CSS-arvoksi ilman yksikkötietoa.
condition: When reviewing scope finlandica examples in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Keep pt sample sizes and tracking units attached to their context.

title: Scope Metropolia examples
guidance: Separate short uppercase headings, long headings and body; retain guideline ratios and example sizes as distinct evidence.
guidance_fi: Erota lyhyt suuraakkosotsikko pitkästä otsikosta ja leipätekstistä. Säilytä ohjeen suhdeluku ja esimerkkikoko erillisinä havaintoina.
condition: When reviewing scope metropolia examples in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Preserve separate Metropolia roles and original ratio/sample evidence.

title: Trial easy-language print
guidance: For easy-language print, trial the guide's 12–16 pt and roughly 50–60 character lines with actual size/readers; numbers do not certify accessibility.
guidance_fi: Kokeile selkopainotuotteessa ohjeen 12–16 pt:tä ja noin 50–60 merkin riviä lukijan ja todellisen koon kanssa. Numero ei ole sertifiointi.
condition: When reviewing trial easy-language print in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Easy-language print trial under source conditions; no readability certificate.

title: Do not freeze print line breaks
guidance: Do not automatically transplant fixed easy-language print breaks to web; test meaning, narrow width and zoom.
guidance_fi: Älä siirrä painetun selkotekstin kiinteitä rivinvaihtoja automaattisesti verkkoon. Testaa merkitys, kapea leveys ja suurennus.
condition: When reviewing do not freeze print line breaks in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Test responsive web behavior before keeping a hard break.

title: Check applicable contrast
guidance: Evaluate applicable WCAG thresholds/exceptions: generally 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text; test dynamic backgrounds/states.
guidance_fi: Arvioi WCAG:n soveltuvat rajat ja poikkeukset: tavallisesti 4,5:1, suurelle tekstille 3:1. Mittaa myös vaihtuvat taustat ja tilat.
condition: When reviewing check applicable contrast in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Apply large-text definition and exceptions; not visual guesswork.

title: Test text resizing
guidance: Test 200% text resizing in the actual browser, including forms/errors; CSS simulation is not browser acceptance.
guidance_fi: Testaa oikeassa selaimessa 200 %:n tekstinsuurennus, myös lomakkeet ja virheilmoitukset. Älä rinnasta CSS-simulaatiota selaintestiin.
condition: When reviewing test text resizing in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Inspect the real browser, controls and error states.

title: Test narrow reflow
guidance: Test 320 CSS px-equivalent reflow without lost information/function; assess inherently two-dimensional exceptions separately.
guidance_fi: Testaa 320 CSS px:n vastaava leveys ilman tiedon tai toiminnon menetystä. Arvioi aidosti kaksiulotteisen sisällön poikkeukset erikseen.
condition: When reviewing test narrow reflow in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: A 390 px screenshot is not this acceptance test.

title: Test spacing overrides
guidance: Test applicable WCAG line/paragraph/letter/word spacing overrides together; they are resilience tests, not mandatory default styling.
guidance_fi: Testaa WCAG:n soveltuvat rivin-, kappaleen-, kirjain- ja sanavälien ylikirjoitukset yhdessä. Ne eivät ole pakollinen oletustyyli.
condition: When reviewing test spacing overrides in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Where applicable, test the simultaneous override; do not force as design defaults.

title: Test numeric features
guidance: Trial tabular figures in comparison tables; verify actual font support separately from locale formatting.
guidance_fi: Kokeile tasalevyisiä numeroita vertailutaulukossa. Varmista fontin tuki erikseen lukujen kieliasun tarkistuksesta.
condition: When reviewing test numeric features in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Verify tabular figures and locale formatting independently.

title: Reopen and inspect exports
guidance: Reopen exports in the target application; check font rights, fallback, wrapping, search, copy, language and reading order.
guidance_fi: Avaa vienti kohdesovelluksessa; tarkista fonttioikeudet, korvaus, rivit, haku, kopiointi, kieli ja lukujärjestys.
condition: When reviewing reopen and inspect exports in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Verify copy/search, font fallback and logical reading order after reopening.

title: Test real Finnish words
guidance: Test äöå, case and repeated vowels/consonants at varied weights/backgrounds; retain spelling.
guidance_fi: Testaa äöå, suuret ja pienet kirjaimet sekä toistuvat vokaalit ja konsonantit eri painoilla ja taustoilla. Säilytä oikeinkirjoitus.
condition: When reviewing test real finnish words in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Check dots/ring, repeated letters and contrast at actual size.

title: Report only executed evidence
guidance: Distinguish source reading, measurement, image inspection and target-application testing; mark unperformed checks not_checked.
guidance_fi: Erota lähteen lukeminen, mittaus, kuvan tarkistus ja kohdesovelluksen testi. Merkitse tekemätön tarkistus not_checked-tilaan.
condition: When reviewing report only executed evidence in a supported Finnish context.
exception: Retain intentional house style, protected quotations, names and machine data; seek authorization before textual edits.

example.note: Do not mark Office/PDF rendering or native host invocation as passed.
